name: Crawler transfer case
_note: A deeper low range for rock crawling: slower, and far more pull.

transferCase._note: A part-time 4WD's transfer case: 2H drives the rear wheels only, 4H locks the front and rear together (no centre diff: for loose ground, it scrubs on tarmac), 4L too, through the low range (lowRatio × every gear: crawling, steep climbs). Into or out of 4L only nearly stopped (below shiftBelow m/s).
